name: Pradilla de Ebro (Spain)
description: Blue field with a green stripe along the hoist, charged at the centre with a yellow octagonal tower between four yellow eight-pointed stars.
history: In 1997 the town council of Pradilla de Ebro was authorised to adopt its heraldic arms and municipal flag; the arms are azure, an octagonal Mudéjar tower or, masoned sable and pierced of the field, accompanied in each corner by an eight-pointed star or, on a base vert fimbriated argent.

features.role: four eight-pointed stars in the corners of the blue
